privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.summary: In short. Without an account your measurements stay in your device's browser and nobody receives them. With an account (optional), measurements, panels, projects and preferences are saved in the cloud so you can find them on other devices. No ads, no usage analytics, no profiling.

controller.title: Data controller
controller.p1: Write to this address with questions about privacy or to exercise your rights. The app's code is public on <gh>GitHub</gh>: you can check what it does with your data.

local.title: Data that stays on your device
local.p1: Notebook measurements, Analysis panels, projects and preferences (theme, whiteboard mode, recent choices) are saved in the browser (IndexedDB and localStorage). They aren't sent to anyone unless you sign in with an account.
local.p2: You can erase them by deleting the site data in the browser settings. Export them first if you want to keep them.

sensors.title: Sensors, microphone, USB and Bluetooth
sensors.p1: Data from Arduino (via cable or Bluetooth), the motion sensors and the microphone is processed in the browser. Microphone audio is neither recorded nor sent: the app only derives frequency and level from it, or the waveform shown on screen.
sensors.p2: If you use a GPS connected to Arduino, the positions are part of the measurement: they stay on the device, or in your account if you sign in.

account.title: Account (optional)
account.p1: Creating an account requires an email address and a password. With the account, the following are saved in the cloud: measurements, panels, projects and lab preferences. Each user can only read and change their own data.
account.p2: We use the email only for signing in and for necessary messages (address confirmation, password recovery). The password is managed by the authentication service and is never visible in plain text.
account.p3: Legal basis: performance of the service you request by creating the account (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR).
account.p4: If you are under 14, create an account only with the consent of a parent or guardian. The app also works without an account.

providers.title: Providers
providers.p1: Supabase stores accounts and synced data, as data processor. Vercel hosts the site and logs technical request data (IP address, browser) to run and protect it. Maps load their images from OpenStreetMap: your IP address and the area shown reach their servers (OpenStreetMap privacy policy).
providers.p2: Some servers may be located outside the European Union: in that case the transfer takes place with the safeguards provided by the GDPR, such as standard contractual clauses.

cookies.title: Cookies and local storage
cookies.p1: We don't use profiling cookies or analytics tools. The browser keeps only what's needed to work: the app data described above and, if you sign in, the account session.

retention.title: How long
retention.p1: Account data is kept as long as the account exists. When you sign out, it disappears from that device but stays in the cloud.
retention.p2: You can delete the account at any time from the app: account menu → “Delete account”. The account, the email address and all synced data (measurements, panels, projects, preferences) are erased immediately and permanently from the server, together with their copies on the device you're using. On other devices the local copies remain until you sign out of the account or delete the site data. Any backup copies held by the provider are deleted through their normal rotation.
retention.p3: If you can't sign in, request deletion at <mail>{contact}</mail>.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.p1: You can request access, rectification, erasure, restriction and portability of your data, and object to the processing. From the app you can already export measurements to Excel or CSV and delete the account with all its data.
rights.p2: If you believe your data is being processed incorrectly, you can lodge a complaint with the <garante>Italian Data Protection Authority (Garante per la protezione dei dati personali)</garante>.

changes.title: Changes
changes.p1: If this notice changes, the date at the top is updated.
